subject.title: fix: prevent ClickClack startup backlog replay

question: Should ClickClack expose `channels.clickclack.backfillOnStart` as the supported way to opt into startup backlog dispatch while changing the default to tail-from-now?
rationale: OpenClaw policy treats new config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive, and this PR turns an accidental multi-page replay path into an explicit supported startup mode.

options.title: Accept explicit backfill opt-in
options.body: Keep `backfillOnStart` after the idempotency fix so safe restarts are the default and operators can intentionally request historical dispatch.

options.title: Remove the new config surface
options.body: Ship only the tail-drain bug fix and avoid supporting startup backlog dispatch as a documented ClickClack mode.

options.title: Preserve legacy replay default
options.body: Do not change cold-start semantics until a broader ClickClack backlog policy is designed, leaving the reported replay problem unresolved for now.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit backfill opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep `backfillOnStart` after the idempotency fix so safe restarts are the default and operators can intentionally request historical dispatch.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a config/product-surface decision for a channel extension whose original implementation and docs history route through this owner signal.
